$comment: Two Circuits, round 2: the Lock Flight through the North Head (docs/specs/ISLAND-03-keelhaven.md §5.3). Part 1 (Q3.8, Stroud) takes your hull from the issue to a pull request through Lock 1; part 2 (Q3.9, Arlo) answers the two seeded pull requests at Lock 2. You seal Gate 1 after the diff and Gate 2 after the checks; the Sea Gate (the merge) stays shut for practice hulls. The hulls' names are the course's pull request titles (quests' signs).

gate1.name: Gate 1
gate1.means: The first approval gate: you decide the diff is ready

petition.name: The petition mast
petition.means: Open the pull request with **Create PR**

lamps.name: The lock lamps
lamps.means: Checks run on the pull request, in the **Pull requests** view

note.name: The chalk note
note.means: A review comment on the pull request

redLamp.name: The red lamp
redLamp.means: A failing check: the **Book app web** check

barge.name: The repair barge
barge.means: A **New session** from the pull request

gate2.name: Gate 2
gate2.means: The second approval gate: you decide it’s ready to merge

laps.title: Lock 1: from an issue to a pull request

stations.title: Issue
stations.prompt: The ledger holds the open work orders.
stations.text: You open the work order Make search case-insensitive in the Issues ledger.

stations.title: Session
stations.prompt: The order rings the bell at the main slipway. Where does the hull start?
stations.caption: The issue, open in **Issues**.

options.text: Drydock 3, on practice-search-case-bug, with Create from
options.result: The hull starts in Drydock 3, where the bug is.

options.text: The main slipway (the issue’s New session button)
options.reason: Search already works on main. There is nothing to fix there.

hints: Where does the bug live?
The issue’s New session starts from main.
Drydock 3, on practice-search-case-bug, with Create from.

stations.title: The inner loop
stations.prompt: Your hull’s on Drydock 3’s slip, and its crew waits for the word.
stations.text: Drydock 3’s crew runs the ring: five lamps light in turn, and the lookout shows hobbit and HOBBIT giving the same result.

stations.title: Diff
stations.prompt: Read the marks on the slate. Is the diff ready for Gate 1?

options.text: Yes: only the search fix and its test
Not yet: add the book card’s polish while the hull’s in
options.reason: That isn’t this issue. The Changes tab should hold only the focused search fix and its test.

hints: What does the issue ask for?
One fix, and the test that proves it.
Yes: only the search fix and its test.

stations.title: Approval gate
stations.prompt: Your approval gate. Read the evidence: the slate shows the search fix and its test. Seal Gate 1, or send it back?

options.text: Seal it: the diff holds only the search fix and its test
options.result: Your seal goes on Gate 1, and the lock opens.

options.text: Send it back: a test file changed too
options.reason: The test is part of the job: the plan asked for a focused regression test. Send back only what isn’t.

options.text: Seal it: Copilot says the fix works
options.reason: A confident response isn’t validated software. Seal on what the diff shows.

hints: What’s on the slate?
The fix and its test are the job.
Seal it: the diff holds only the search fix and its test.

stations.title: Pull request
stations.prompt: Build the summary from what you saw, then hoist it (Create PR).

tiles.text: Tests and build passed in the terminal
hobbit and HOBBIT match in the preview

tiles.reason: No check has run yet. Claim only what the terminal or CI output shows.

stations.title: Checks
stations.prompt: Your petition’s up: the pull request is open.
stations.text: Lockfall’s leat fills Lock 1. The Book app web lamp runs amber, then green.

stations.title: The merge
stations.prompt: Your hull’s through Lock 1, her pull request open. The Sea Gate is the merge. Open it?

options.text: Keep it shut: it’s practice, and main already has the fix
options.result: The Sea Gate stays shut, and your hull waits above it: open, not merged.

options.text: Open it: every lamp is green
options.reason: Not this one. Don’t merge this practice pull request: the correct search behavior is already on main.

hints: Where does the search fix already live?
main has it. This one’s practice.
Keep it shut.

laps.title: Lock 2: a note and a red lamp
laps.order: Improve empty-state copy · Failing stats check practice

stations.title: Feedback
stations.prompt: The note asks for more helpful guidance. The barge comes alongside. Choose the revision.
stations.caption: The comment on **Improve empty-state copy**.

options.text: A message that names the search term, the genre and the reading status
A message that names the search term only
Rewrite the whole page

hints: What does the comment ask for?
Answer all of it, and change no more than that.
A message that names the search term, the genre and the reading status.

stations.title: Push
stations.prompt: The revision’s ready in your session.
stations.text: The pull request shows your new commit, and Lockfall runs the lamp again. Green.

stations.title: Checks
stations.prompt: Stats Check’s Book app web lamp is red: the favorites ballast is wrong. The barge comes alongside. What do you do?
stations.caption: The failed **Book app web** check.

options.text: Re-ballast the hull: count favorites for read and unread books, and leave the gauge alone
options.result: The smallest fix, and the test stays as it is.

options.text: File down the gauge (change the test’s expected count)
options.reason: The lamp turns green and the hull lists. Don’t weaken the failing test.

options.text: Run the lamp again until it’s green
options.reason: It stays red. The code is still wrong.

hints: Which is wrong: the hull or the gauge?
Fix the code. Keep the test.
Re-ballast the hull, and leave the gauge alone.

stations.title: The inner loop
stations.prompt: The barge comes alongside your hull.
stations.text: The barge’s own small ring: the tests, the build and the preview.

stations.title: Push
stations.prompt: The fix passed the barge’s ring.

stations.title: Approval gate
stations.prompt: Gate 2 opens when its four lamps agree. Read them as they light. The last one is your review.

options.text: Seal it: the diff, local validation, the checks and your review agree
Seal it now: the Book app web check is green
options.reason: One green lamp isn’t enough. A change is ready only when the diff, local validation, GitHub checks and human review agree.

options.text: Leave it to the tug (Agent Merge)
options.reason: Agent Merge is a finishing aid, not a replacement for human review. The last lamp is your own review.

hints: How many lamps must agree?
All four. The last is yours.
Seal it once the diff, local validation and checks are lit, and you’ve reviewed it.

stations.title: The merge
stations.prompt: Both hulls are through, Gate 2 sealed. The Sea Gate is the merge. Open it?

options.text: Keep it shut: these are practice pull requests
options.result: The hulls wait in the basin with a white pennant: done, and not merged.

options.text: Open it: Gate 2 is sealed
options.reason: Gate 2 says they’re ready. The course doesn’t ask you to merge these practice pull requests: they stay open.

hints: Does the course ask you to merge them?
They’re practice.
Keep it shut.

text.title: The Lock Flight
text.intro: The outer loop: issue, session, diff, pull request, checks. Two approval gates are yours.
text.actions: No lamp after a push? New forks turn workflows off: turn them on in your fork’s Actions tab.
